workflow-quarto.name: Quarto
workflow-quarto.description: Write notebooks as Quarto documents (.qmd), or R Markdown in R projects. Quarto renders them to HTML, PDF, and Word.

workflow-jupyter.name: Jupyter
workflow-jupyter.description: Write notebooks in Jupyter (.ipynb) with the kernel for the project's language. Quarto stays available to render and publish them.

workflow-scripts.name: Scripts only
workflow-scripts.description: No notebooks. Analysis lives in scripts, and the blueprint supplies any starter scripts.
